titleByLocale.it: Titolare del progetto e dei costi

jobs.description:
To strengthen our Finance & Risk department, we are looking for an:

PROJECT & COST CONTROLLER

(12 months fixed-term contract)

Your mission will consist of partnering with project leaders and local finance teams to oversee government project profitability throughout deployment and operations across Swiss and local entities.

ROLE

• Consolidate customer and designated internal project financials across entities; monitor revenue, costs, investments, assets, consumables and headcount monthly against budgets and project charters.

• Explain variances, assess financial risks and provide profitability, investment and resource analyses to support project decisions.

• Support local finance teams with project monitoring and closings, validate revenue recognition and ensure visibility over Swiss invoicing, assets and consumables.

• Coordinate budgets, forecasts and system submissions with project teams; incorporate actual performance into Business Finance model updates.

• Ensure consistent centre-of-excellence and intercompany cost allocations; back up project transfer pricing calculations and SAP input.

• Track intercompany fixed-asset margin eliminations and coordinate related depreciation adjustments with Consolidation.

PROFILE

• Bachelor degree in Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent

• Minimum 5-8 years experience ideally in controlling, reporting or related sector

• Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI are a major asset

• Experience in SAP/S4Hana ERP

• Analytical mind-set and detail-oriented person.

• Proactive and forward-thinking, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation

• Team Spirit & (internal) customer oriented

• Fast learner, works independently with ability to multi-task

• Fluent in English, French and Spanish would be an asset

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

• Monitor project actuals against planned budgets and escalate risks where appropriate.

Per rafforzare il nostro dipartimento Finance & Risk, stiamo cercando un:

PROGETTO & COST CONTROLLER

(12 mesi a tempo determinato)

La vostra missione consisterà nel collaborare con i responsabili del progetto e con i team di finanza locale per supervisionare la redditività del progetto governativo durante l'implementazione e le operazioni tra enti svizzeri e locali.

RUOLO

• Consolidare il cliente e designare i finanziamenti per progetti interni in tutte le entità; monitorare i ricavi, i costi, gli investimenti, i beni, i materiali di consumo e il conto capo mensile contro budget e le carte di progetto.

• Spiegare variazioni, valutare i rischi finanziari e fornire analisi di redditività, investimento e risorse per sostenere le decisioni del progetto.

• Sostenere i team di finanza locale con monitoraggio e chiusura dei progetti, convalidare il riconoscimento dei ricavi e garantire la visibilità sulla fatturazione svizzera, sui beni e sui materiali di consumo.

• Coordinare budget, previsioni e sottomissioni di sistema con i team di progetto; incorporare le prestazioni effettive negli aggiornamenti del modello Business Finance.

• Assicurare allocazioni di costi coerenti di centro-di eccellenza e intercompany; eseguire il backup dei calcoli dei prezzi del trasferimento di progetto e dell'ingresso SAP.

• Traccia le eliminazioni dei margini di asse fisso e coordina le relative regolazioni di ammortamento con Consolidamento.

PROFESSIONALE

• Laurea in Finanza, Business Administration, o equivalente

• Esperienza minima di 5-8 anni ideale per il controllo, la segnalazione o il settore relativo

• La competenza in Excel e PowerBI è una risorsa importante

• Esperienza in SAP/S4Hana ERP

• Persona analitica e orientata al dettaglio.

• Proattivi e avanzati, con un focus sul miglioramento continuo e sull'innovazione

• Team Spirit & (internal) orientato al cliente

• Imparente veloce, lavora indipendentemente con la capacità di multi-task

• Fluente in inglese, francese e spagnolo sarebbe un bene

Perche'?

• Unisciti a un leader globale nelle tecnologie di fiducia con una missione che conta.

• Essere al centro strategico di un'azienda finanziariamente solida e innovativa.

• Collabora con esperti di alto livello e lavori su progetti internazionali d'impatto.

• Operare in un ambiente multi-culturale e ad alta intensità in cui l'autonomia e la proprietà sono incoraggiati.

• Monitorare gli effetti del progetto contro i bilanci pianificati e i rischi di escalation, se del caso.

Zur Stärkung unserer Finance & Risk Abteilung suchen wir:

PROJEKT- UND KOSTENKONTROLLER

(12 Monate befristeter Vertrag)

• Varianzen erklären, finanzielle Risiken bewerten und Rentabilitäts-, Investitions- und Ressourcenanalysen zur Unterstützung von Projektentscheidungen bereitstellen.

• Unterstützen Sie lokale Finanzteams bei der Projektüberwachung und -schließung, validieren Sie die Umsatzerfassung und gewährleisten Sie die Transparenz über die Schweizer Rechnungsstellung, Vermögenswerte und Verbrauchsmaterialien.

• Koordinieren Sie Budgets, Prognosen und Systemeinreichungen mit Projektteams; integrieren Sie die tatsächliche Leistung in die Aktualisierungen des Business Finance-Modells.

• Gewährleistung einer konsistenten Center-of-Excellence- und Intercompany-Kostenallokation; Sicherung der Berechnung der Projekttransferpreise und des SAP-Inputs.

• Nachverfolgung der Einschusszahlungen zwischen Unternehmen und Koordinierung der damit verbundenen Abschreibungsanpassungen mit Consolidation.

PROFIL

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft oder gleichwertig

• Mindestens 5-8 Jahre Erfahrung idealerweise im Controlling, Reporting oder verwandten Sektor

• Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerBI sind ein wichtiger Vorteil

• Erfahrung in SAP/S4Hana ERP

• Analytische Denkweise und detailorientierte Person.

• Proaktives und vorausschauendes Denken mit Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Innovation

• Team Spirit & (intern) kundenorientiert

• Schneller Lernender, arbeitet unabhängig mit Multi-Task-Fähigkeit

• Fließend in Englisch, Französisch und Spanisch wäre ein Vermögenswert

WARUM UNS JOIN?

• Schließen Sie sich einem globalen Marktführer für Vertrauenstechnologien mit einer Mission an, die wichtig ist.

• Seien Sie im strategischen Herzen eines finanziell soliden und innovationsgetriebenen Unternehmens.

• Arbeiten Sie mit hochrangigen Experten zusammen und arbeiten Sie an wirkungsvollen internationalen Projekten.

• Arbeiten Sie in einem multikulturellen, hochintegrierten Umfeld, in dem Autonomie und Besitz gefördert werden.

• Überwachen Sie die Istwerte des Projekts im Vergleich zu geplanten Budgets und eskalieren Sie gegebenenfalls Risiken.

Pour renforcer notre ministère des Finances et des Risques, nous cherchons :

CONTRÔLE DES PROJETS ET DES COÛTS

(12 mois de contrat à durée déterminée)

Votre mission consistera à s'associer avec les chefs de projet et les équipes financières locales pour superviser la rentabilité des projets gouvernementaux tout au long du déploiement et des opérations dans les entités suisses et locales.

RÔLE

• Consolider les finances des clients et des projets internes désignés entre les entités; surveiller les revenus, les coûts, les investissements, les actifs, les consommables et les comptes mensuels par rapport aux budgets et aux chartes de projets.

• Expliquer les écarts, évaluer les risques financiers et fournir des analyses de rentabilité, d'investissement et de ressources à l'appui des décisions des projets.

• Soutenir les équipes financières locales avec le suivi et la clôture des projets, valider la reconnaissance des revenus et assurer la visibilité sur la facturation suisse, les actifs et les consommables.

• Coordonner les budgets, les prévisions et les présentations de systèmes avec les équipes de projet; intégrer le rendement réel aux mises à jour du modèle de financement des affaires.

• Assurer une répartition uniforme des coûts entre les centres d'excellence et les entreprises; appuyer les calculs des prix de transfert des projets et les données SAP.

• Suivre les suppressions de marge d'actif fixe interentreprises et coordonner les ajustements d'amortissement connexes avec la consolidation.

PROFIL

• Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires ou équivalent

• Au moins 5-8 ans d'expérience idéalement dans le contrôle, la déclaration ou le secteur connexe

• La compétence en Excel et en PowerBI est un atout majeur

• Expérience de SAP/S4Hana ERP

• Un état d'esprit analytique et une personne axée sur les détails.

• Proactive et prospective, l'accent étant mis sur l'amélioration continue et l'innovation

• Team Spirit & (interne) orienté client

• Apprentis rapide, travaille indépendamment avec la capacité à multi-tâche

• L'anglais, le français et l'espagnol seraient un atout

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Rejoignez un leader mondial des technologies de confiance avec une mission qui compte.

• Soyez au cœur stratégique d'une entreprise financièrement saine et axée sur l'innovation.

• Collaborer avec des experts de haut niveau et travailler sur des projets internationaux ayant un impact.

• Fonctionnement dans un environnement multiculturel et à haute intégrité où l'autonomie et la propriété sont encouragées.

• Surveiller les résultats réels du projet par rapport aux budgets prévus et augmenter les risques, le cas échéant.

jobs.title: AI & Data Solution Expert

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en solutions de données et d'IA

jobs.description:
To strengthen our GLOBAL INFORMATION SERVICES department, we are looking for a:

AI & DATA SOLUTION EXPERT

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Data & AI Solution Expert to shape the technical direction of our enterprise Data & AI ecosystem and turn advanced data and Generative AI capabilities into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.

This senior individual-contributor role combines architecture with hands-on delivery across Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, Power BI and enterprise AI. Working with engineering, architecture, security and business teams, you will define reusable standards, guide strategic designs and help move critical data and AI solutions from concept to operation in a regulated environment.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

• Contribute to defining the Data & AI solution architecture, reference patterns and technical standards aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, security and governance requirements.

• Design and evolve the enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric and SQL Server, covering ingestion, Lakehouse and Warehouse layers, data modeling, performance,  resilience and lifecycle management.

• Scale trusted analytics through reusable Power BI semantic models, shared KPIs, certified  datasets and governed self-service reporting.

• Design and deliver Generative AI applications, RAG solutions and governed data agents using Azure OpenAI and the Microsoft AI ecosystem, from  prototype through secure production deployment.

• Contribute to defining and implementing engineering, DevOps,  MLOps and LLMOps practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and rollback.

• Embed data governance,  security and Responsible AI into solutions through metadata, lineage, data quality, access controls, traceability, evaluation and human oversight.

• Contribute senior technical  expertise , mentor engineers, review strategic designs and explain technical options and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

YOUR PROFILE:

• Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise data, analytics or AI solutions, supported by a relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Advanced SQL and Microsoft SQL Server knowledge, with experience in data modeling, query optimization, Data Warehouse,  Lakehouse and ETL/ELT architectures.

• Hands-on Power BI  expertise , particularly semantic modeling, shared datasets, security and enterprise deployment.

• Practical experience with a modern cloud Data & AI platform; Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred.

• Experience delivering Generative AI solutions using Azure OpenAI or comparable enterprise LLM technologies, with knowledge of RAG, semantic or vector search, grounding,  agents and tool calling.

• Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment  automation and the operational requirements of MLOps or LLMOps .

• Good understanding of enterprise security, identity, access management, data  governance and Responsible AI.

• Ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture,  governance and business teams, with professional proficiency in English.

JOIN US !

• Our success comes from our highly skilled and talented employees.

• Respectful entrepreneurship and long-term vision are key for success.

• Our people contribute to a more secure world.

• Diversity at all levels of an organisation is a strength.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

ESPERTO DI SOLUZIONE AI & D

Stiamo cercando un Data & AI Solution Expert per modellare la direzione tecnica dell'ecosistema aziendale Data & AI e trasformare i dati avanzati e le capacità AI Generative in soluzioni sicure, scalabili e pronte alla produzione.

• Competenza BI di Hands-on Power, modellazione particolarmente semantica, dataset condivisi, sicurezza e distribuzione aziendale.

• Esperienza pratica con una moderna piattaforma cloud Data & AI; Microsoft Fabric è fortemente preferito.

• Buona comprensione della sicurezza aziendale, identità, gestione degli accessi, governance dei dati e AI responsabile.

• Capacità di collaborare tra team di ingegneria, architettura, governance e business, con competenza professionale in inglese.

JOIN US!

jobs.description:
The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position.

The in-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands-on partner to the business, advising on day-to-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research & Innovation (R&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution.

The role requires a proactive, collaborative approach, working across R&I, Commercial and Legal teams to ensure that intellectual property protection supports the company's broader business objectives. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise messages and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels is essential.

Key responsibilities

• Work closely with the Research & Innovation team, harvest and capture innovation. Pro-actively look for inventions and create and maintain awareness about use and necessity of patent applications.

• Contribute to the acquisition, protection, defence and enforcement (drafting, filing, prosecution, opposition, appeal, etc.) of patent rights; prosecution of a global patent portfolio in the assigned technical areas.

• Provide comprehensive patent support to selected projects as an integral member of multidisciplinary project teams.

• Formulate strategic practice recommendations in response to commercial, legal and technical developments, this includes evaluating patent validity, patent risk management and infringement issues and reviewing IP-related agreements.

Essential duties

• Analysis of the innovation and potential inventions, drafting, filing of patent applications and worldwide prosecution; therefore, drafting skills are essential here and prosecution, opposition and infringement matters offer a wide variety of work.

• Liaise prior art search reports from external providers and assess feasibility and patentability.

• Draft IP related aspects of agreements with third-party collaborators and service providers.

• Oversee patent risk management and provide Freedom to Operate opinion and clearance studies.

• Working closely with R&I division, sales and legal and promote patent culture with good visibility within the company. The direct contact with international colleagues and clients will require commitment, passion, strong communication skills and commercial savviness.

Profile

• PhD (preferred) or master’s degree in chemistry.

• Be passionate about the technology you work with and follow the developments within the industry with invested interest.

• Qualified European Patent Attorney. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in drafting and prosecuting patent cases after EPA qualification.

• Proactive, structured with a collaborative working style with solid team player attributes with the ability to manage relationships with different stakeholders in the company.

• Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to work with cross-functional teams across departments and divisions.

• Show flexibility under stress and delivers quality work with strong attention to detail in an autonomous manner.

• Fluent in English, French a strong asset is a plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'obiettivo primario di questo ruolo è quello di garantire che l'identificazione, l'estrazione e la protezione della tecnologia siano allineati con le attività aziendali nel campo della chimica. Una forte comprensione delle tecnologie sottostanti e delle loro applicazioni commerciali è quindi essenziale per il successo in questa posizione.

Il Procuratore Brevetti in-house agirà come partner pratico per l'azienda, consigliando le opportunità di sviluppo aziendale quotidiane e assicurando che le nuove innovazioni siano effettivamente identificate e protette attraverso i brevetti. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team Research & Innovation (R&I) e con il dipartimento IP, il ruolo si concentrerà sull'estrazione dell'innovazione, sulla stesura dei brevetti e sull'esecuzione.

Il ruolo richiede un approccio proattivo e collaborativo, lavorando in team R&I, Commerciale e Legale per garantire che la protezione della proprietà intellettuale supporti gli obiettivi aziendali più ampi. La capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e concisi e comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli è essenziale.

Responsabilità chiave

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di ricerca e innovazione, raccogliere e catturare l'innovazione. Pro-attivamente cercare invenzioni e creare e mantenere la consapevolezza sull'uso e la necessità di domande di brevetto.

• Contribuire all'acquisizione, alla protezione, alla difesa e all'applicazione (disegno, deposito, perseguimento, opposizione, appello, ecc.) dei diritti di brevetto; l'esecuzione di un portafoglio brevetti globale nelle aree tecniche assegnate.

• Fornire un supporto completo ai brevetti per i progetti selezionati come parte integrante dei team di progetto multidisciplinari.

• Formulare raccomandazioni pratiche strategiche in risposta agli sviluppi commerciali, legali e tecnici, questo include la valutazione della validità del brevetto, la gestione del rischio di brevetto e le questioni di infrazione e la revisione degli accordi IP correlati.

Obblighi essenziali

• L'analisi dell'innovazione e delle potenziali invenzioni, la redazione, il deposito delle domande di brevetto e l'accusa in tutto il mondo; pertanto, le competenze di redazione sono essenziali qui e l'accusa, l'opposizione e le questioni di infrazione offrono una vasta gamma di lavoro.

• Liaise rapporti di ricerca di arte precedenti da fornitori esterni e valutare la fattibilità e la brevettabilità.

• Progetto di aspetti relativi all'IP degli accordi con collaboratori e fornitori di servizi di terze parti.

• Superare la gestione dei rischi di brevetto e fornire la libertà di operare studi di opinione e sdoganamento.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la divisione R&I, vendite e legale e promuovere la cultura dei brevetti con una buona visibilità all'interno dell'azienda. Il contatto diretto con colleghi e clienti internazionali richiederà impegno, passione, forti capacità di comunicazione e savviness commerciale.

Profilo

• PhD (preferito) o master in chimica.

• Siate appassionati della tecnologia con cui si lavora e seguire gli sviluppi all'interno del settore con interesse investito.

• Avvocato europeo di brevetto qualificato. Minimo 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante nella redazione e nell'esecuzione di casi di brevetto dopo la qualifica EPA.

• Proattivo, strutturato con uno stile di lavoro collaborativo con solidi attributi del giocatore di squadra con la capacità di gestire i rapporti con diversi stakeholder dell'azienda.

• Possiede una forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per lavorare con team interfunzionali in tutti i dipartimenti e le divisioni.

• Mostra flessibilità sotto stress e offre un lavoro di qualità con una forte attenzione ai dettagli in modo autonomo.

• Fluente in inglese, francese un bene forte è un plus

Das Hauptziel dieser Rolle ist es, sicherzustellen, dass Technologieidentifikation, -gewinnung und -schutz mit den Geschäftsaktivitäten im Bereich der Chemie in Einklang stehen. Ein starkes Verständnis der zugrunde liegenden Technologien und ihrer kommerziellen Anwendungen ist daher für den Erfolg in dieser Position unerlässlich.

Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte in klare, prägnante Botschaften zu übersetzen und effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zu kommunizieren, ist unerlässlich.

L'objectif principal de ce rôle est de veiller à ce que l'identification, l'extraction et la protection des technologies soient alignées sur les activités commerciales dans le domaine de la chimie. Une bonne compréhension des technologies sous-jacentes et de leurs applications commerciales est donc essentielle au succès de cette position.

L'avocat en brevets agira comme partenaire pratique de l'entreprise, conseillera sur les possibilités de développement commercial au quotidien et veillera à ce que les nouvelles innovations soient identifiées et protégées efficacement par des brevets. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de recherche et d'innovation (R-I) et le département de la propriété intellectuelle, le rôle sera axé sur l'extraction de l'innovation, la rédaction des brevets et les poursuites.

Ce rôle exige une approche proactive et collaborative, qui s'appuie sur les équipes de R-I, commerciale et juridique pour s'assurer que la protection de la propriété intellectuelle appuie les objectifs généraux de l'entreprise. La capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en messages clairs et concis et de communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux est essentielle.

Principales responsabilités

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Recherche et innovation, récolter et saisir l'innovation. Recherche proactive d'inventions et sensibilisation à l'utilisation et à la nécessité des demandes de brevet.

• Contribuer à l'acquisition, à la protection, à la défense et à l'exécution (élaboration, dépôt, poursuite, opposition, recours, etc.) des droits de brevet; poursuivre un portefeuille mondial de brevets dans les domaines techniques assignés.

• Fournir un soutien complet en matière de brevets à certains projets en tant que membre à part entière d'équipes de projets multidisciplinaires.

• Formuler des recommandations stratégiques en réponse aux développements commerciaux, juridiques et techniques, ce qui comprend l'évaluation de la validité des brevets, la gestion des risques de brevet et les questions de contrefaçon et l'examen des accords relatifs à la propriété intellectuelle.

Fonctions essentielles

• L'analyse de l'innovation et des inventions potentielles, la rédaction, le dépôt des demandes de brevet et les poursuites à l'échelle mondiale; par conséquent, les compétences en matière de rédaction sont essentielles à cet égard et les questions de poursuite, d'opposition et de contrefaçon offrent une grande variété de travaux.

• Établir des rapports de recherche sur l'état de la technique auprès de fournisseurs externes et évaluer la faisabilité et la brevetabilité.

• Projet d'accord relatif à la propriété intellectuelle avec des tiers collaborateurs et fournisseurs de services.

• Superviser la gestion des risques liés aux brevets et fournir la liberté d'exercer des études d'opinion et d'autorisation.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la division R&I, les ventes et la législation et promouvoir la culture des brevets avec une bonne visibilité au sein de l'entreprise. Le contact direct avec des collègues et des clients internationaux nécessitera de l'engagement, de la passion, de solides compétences en communication et de la sagesse commerciale.

Profil

• Doctorat (préféré) ou maîtrise en chimie.

• Soyez passionné par la technologie avec laquelle vous travaillez et suivez les développements au sein de l'industrie avec intérêt.

• Conseil européen des brevets. Au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la rédaction et la poursuite des demandes de brevet après la qualification de l'EPA.

• Proactive, structurée avec un style de travail collaboratif avec des attributs de joueur d'équipe solide avec la capacité de gérer les relations avec les différents intervenants de l'entreprise.

• Posséder de solides compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles pour travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles à travers les départements et les divisions.

jobs.description:
ROLE

•    Strengthen observability and diagnostics for SDKs and reference apps using Splunk and other tools (logs, metrics, crash signals, field diagnostics).
•    Build and own engineering tooling and automation, and define a multi-quarter platform roadmap, to measurably reduce operational workload and increase developer productivity at scale across the team (~20 engineers), while reducing integration and support effort.
•    Design, implement, and maintain Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery pipelines and quality gates (Jenkins) for mobile SDKs (build, test, packaging, release validation, regression detection).
•    Develop release qualification frameworks: automated functional tests, performance benchmarks, compatibility checks, and reproducible test environments.
•    Deliver and evolve core components of mobile SDKs (iOS, Android): camera capture, image processing pipelines, API design, modularization, documentation, smartphone apps.
•    Provide technical leadership as an Individual Contributor (no management): architecture decisions, design reviews, mentoring through code reviews, and raising engineering standards.
•    Lead the integration of AI/ML into the mobile detection stack, from rapid prototyping to production-grade deployment on iOS/Android.
•    Build an AI-driven validation and triage layer for SDK releases, including automated regression and anomaly detection.

PROFILE

•    Principal Engineer with a strong track record of delivering production software.
•    Proven experience building developer tooling / automation platforms that measurably improve team productivity (e.g., faster releases, fewer regressions, reduced support load).
•    Strong iOS expertise: Swift, Xcode, SDK design and packaging, performance profiling (Instruments); Objective C is a plus.
•    Solid Android foundations: Kotlin/Java, Gradle, CameraX/Camera2, instrumentation/testing; ability to support and debug across both platforms.
•    Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts and implementation experience with Jenkins (pipelines, build/test orchestration, quality gates, artifacts, release processes).
•    Strong knowledge of software architecture, API design, testing strategy, secure coding practices, and maintaining high-quality codebases.
•    Hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision / image processing pipelines on mobile devices and under real-world constraints (latency, memory, device variability).
•    Strong problem‑solving skills, translating customer needs into scalable solutions.
•    Hands‑on experience deploying AI/ML models to production on resource‑constrained, heterogeneous devices.
•    Solid expertise in the full ML lifecycle, including data quality, evaluation, robustness, and model release management.
•    Practical experience with on-device ML toolchains and runtimes and performance engineering under real device constraints.
•    Ability to define and enforce AI usage standards in an industrial environment.
•    Strong communication and collaboration skills in multicultural environments; fluent English, French is a strong plus.

WHY JOIN US?

•    Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.
•    Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.
•    Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.
•    Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.
